fusions.name: Sun-Still Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at one enemy from stillness, dealing 13 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Frill Flare
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health to flare a frill of sun-warmed petals across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage and setting every enemy hit [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Regrow
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Noon Basking
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 12% more damage.
